### `jsonpartial` matcher

Partial JSON containment, value is a STRING of JSON text representing the expected subset. Registry key is single-token lowercase `jsonpartial`. https://docs.hoverfly.io/en/latest/pages/keyconcepts/matching/matchers.html

**Value type:** `string`
**Config:** not supported.
**doMatch:** AND-semantics; re-tests the same input against the next matcher.
